ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe exhibits a dominant white field from the mid-section to trailing edge with dense, dark vertical mottling; right lobe is predominantly low-intensity black with sparse white punctate spots clustered near the trailing edge and median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 42 degrees and a bounding-box depth relative to lobe height of 0.15.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern with pixel-amplitudes of 5-15 pixels along the entire trailing edge; highest amplitude variations localized at the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the posterior edge leading to distal tips that exhibit a sharp, upward-tapering sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible clusters of circular high-contrast white pixels (3-8 pixel diameter) localized along the peripheral margins and trailing edge of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear rake marks observed on the white surface of the left lobe, primarily oriented in a vertical and diagonal-to-central-notch direction.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme jaggedness and irregular tissue loss at the distal tip of the right lobe, indicating significant past trauma or amputation of the fluke tip edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced pigmentation asymmetry where the left lobe is significantly higher in overall pixel intensity than the right lobe.
